implement_Future_cancel: implement a Future subclass that cancels a pending computation and returns a boolean
implement_Future_result: implement a Future subclass that returns the result of a completed computation with timeout support
implement_Future_add_done_callback: implement a Future subclass that registers a callback function to invoke when the computation completes
implement_Future_exception: implement a Future subclass that returns the exception raised by a failed computation
implement_Future_traceback: implement a Future subclass that returns the traceback of an exception raised by the computation
